---
title: "Graphviz Revealjs"
format: revealjs
# bd-ijlapt70: same transform output inside a reveal deck. The diagram
# <pre> sits inside a slide <section>, and the runtime script reaches
# the deck through the rendered.includes.after-body slot.
#
# This is the case most at risk of silent regression: the reveal
# scaffold collects only `js:revealjs:*` artifacts, so keying the
# runtime as a template script would emit no tag here at all.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["section pre.graphviz"]
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "<pre class=\"graphviz\">",
            "<script src=\"[^\"]*graphviz/viz-global\\.js\" charset=\"utf-8\"></script>",
            "Viz\\.instance\\(\\)",
          ]
        - ["cdn\\.jsdelivr\\.net"]
---
